service_notes: Rotary mulching head grinds brush, invasive species and small trees on site instead of hauling debris away or burning it. The mulch layer holds topsoil, cuts erosion and slows regrowth of weeds and briars. Reaches steep slopes and dense brush a bulldozer cannot work safely. Clears combustible undergrowth around structures. Selective: takes the invasive growth and leaves the trees the owner wants. Typical buyers are owners of overgrown acreage in the Western North Carolina foothills, new homesite buyers, and people creating defensible space or pasture.
